payload.author: claude
payload.body: OIDC half DONE + on PR #8 (commit 77e90c3): POST /auth/oidc/:id/verify reusing the FR-269 RS256 verifier; per-provider iss/aud/jwks pinning (cross-provider replay rejected — regression-tested), required nonce, provider-id-scoped subject (oidc:<id>:<sub>, same-sub-distinct-accounts regression-tested), FRICK_OIDC_PROVIDERS config with fatal-on-malformed parsing. Adversarial security review passed clean. SAML split out to FR-280 (XML-dsig is a distinct, higher-risk effort).
